items.title: Tumult Hype Support
items.summary: Need a hand?Tumult Hype is a powerful tool for creating HTML5 animations. To get up to speed with Tumult Hype, we recommend checking out the documentation & tutorials or viewing our introductory videos. We also share a number of animations on in our gallery that you can download and explore.
